brief:
Settlers stole herds of livestock in the Ma'in area east of Yatta, the Maan news agency reported, as Israeli occupation forces opened heavy fire in the region.

The incident occurred during what witnesses described as a coordinated operation in the area. Heavy gunfire from occupation forces accompanied the theft, according to the agency's account of events in the southern West Bank locality.
title: Settlers steal livestock as Israeli army fires heavily near Yatta
